sloka: पुनरेव महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली।संसृज्य बाणवर्षं च शस्त्रवर्षं च दारुणम्।ममर्द वानरानीकमिन्द्रजित्त्वरितो बली ।। ६.७३.४८ ।।
transliteration: punareva mahātejā rākṣasendrātmajo balī।saṁsṛjya bāṇavarṣaṁ ca śastravarṣaṁ ca dāruṇam।mamarda vānarānīkamindrajittvarito balī ।। 6.73.48 ।।

translations.english: Then he struck Jambavan with ten, Neela with thirty, and Sugriva, Rshaba and Angada. In the same way Dwivida with sharp and terrific arrows that were bestowed upon him as boons and made them lose consciousness.
